name: Tula
personality: Charming, diplomatic, fair-minded, artistic, social, and peace-loving. Naturally seeks balance and harmonious relationships.
relationships: Romantic, affectionate, and committed. Values equality, trust, mutual respect, and emotional harmony in partnerships.
health: Kidneys, lower back, urinary system, skin, and hormonal balance.
description: Tula is the seventh sign of the zodiac, symbolizing balance, justice, beauty, relationships, and cooperation. Ruled by Venus, it represents diplomacy, refinement, artistic appreciation, and the ability to create harmony in both personal and professional life.
